text:
Building tools that bridge the gap between data and human connection in adtech is where I thrive. My work isn’t just about code—it’s about crafting experiences that feel intuitive, fast, and meaningful. At AdVantage Media, I focus on shaping the front end of campaigns that reach millions, ensuring every interaction is as seamless as it is impactful.  

Over the past two years, I’ve helped scale our platform to handle complex ad workflows, prioritizing accessibility and performance without sacrificing creativity. One project stood out: reimagining a dashboard for real-time analytics, which reduced load times by 40% while maintaining a responsive, user-first design. These wins aren’t just metrics—they’re steps toward making technology feel less like a barrier and more like a bridge.  

I’m always eager to collaborate on projects that challenge the status quo, whether it’s refining TypeScript-driven architectures or exploring new ways to integrate REST APIs with front-end innovation. If you’re building something that blends utility with elegance, let’s connect—there’s always room to grow, learn, and push boundaries together.
